text:
sylvia_fin: Heads-up — CloudWave reported two April invoices for them. One invoice is missing the reserved_gpu line; the other looks like a duplicate with a bigger total. I put PDFs in ticket #4999.

Tom_support: Can you paste the invoice IDs and the customer impact?

sylvia_fin: IDs: inv-2026-04-cwave-2044 and inv-2026-04-cwave-2044-copy. The copy totals $18,900 vs original $13,600. Customer already flagged as potential overbilling.

arthur_engineer: Quick scan of billing-worker logs: we see a retry after a DB deadlock and the retry path didn't set the dedupe key because webhook payload sometimes arrives without webhook_uuid for ~2s when downstream gateway warms up. That allows two successful invoice generations for the same batch. Snippet:```[2026-04-05T07:12:01Z] bill-worker v3.9 ERROR: db_deadlock txn=0x4f2 retrying
[2026-04-05T07:12:02Z] bill-worker v3.9 INFO: retrying invoice_job batch=202604-204, dedupe_key=null
[2026-04-05T07:12:03Z] bill-worker v3.9 INFO: invoice generated inv-2026-04-cwave-2044````

lucy_billing: Ok that explains dup. What about the missing reserved_gpu line?

arthur_engineer: Also found a pricing mapping mismatch in code: metadata key expected "reserved_gpu-a100" but the pricing table has "reserved_gpu_a100" (underscore vs dash). When lookup fails we don't raise an error, we just skip attaching that line. Bug: PRICING-2217 covers stricter validation.

mike_ops: So combined failure: retry produced a duplicate invoice AND a mapping lookup dropped a line on one run. Net result: duplicated invoice may have different line composition and totals.

billing-bot: automated note: invoice_job batch=202604-204 attempted=2 status=success generated=[inv-2026-04-cwave-2044, inv-2026-04-cwave-2044] duplicate_check=missed

lucy_billing: Finance plan proposal: 1) hold on voiding until eng confirms replay outcome; 2) after patch & replay, void the incorrect duplicate invoice and reissue corrected one with reserved_gpu line; 3) if customer was charged twice, issue immediate refund/credit and notify. Agree?

sylvia_fin: Agree. I'll draft the customer notification and prepare the credit. Please confirm replay steps and signal when safe to proceed.

arthur_engineer: I'll land a hotfix to ensure dedupe key is always set on retry and add a strict mapping assert (CHORE-6010). I'll run a staging replay with `billing-replay --batch 202604-204 --dry-run --dedupe-key webhook_uuid` and share the diffs.

mike_ops: After dry-run, we'll run prod replay in a 10-min maintenance window and watch invoice webhook deliveries.

lucy_billing: Once replay confirms single correct invoice, finance will void the duplicate (inv-2026-04-cwave-2044-copy) and reissue the fixed one. We'll attach credit memo if charge already processed.

billing-bot: automated note: CHORE-6010 deployed to staging at 2026-04-05T12:22Z.

arthur_engineer: Staging replay dry-run shows dedupe catches duplicate and mapping assert adds missing reserved_gpu line. Output totals match expected. Scheduling prod deploy in 20m.

sylvia_fin: Thanks. After prod replay + void/reissue we'll update the customer. Action items: (a) eng deploy CHORE-6010 & run prod replay (arthur), (b) finance void/reissue & credit (lucy/sylvia), (c) ops monitor webhook delivery (mike), (d) update postmortem & add runbook step to fail loud on missing pricing keys (owner: lucy).
